newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-Oct copper exports fall 6.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-Oct copper exports fall 6.8 pct.

text.p: China's exports of uncast and raw copper slipped 6.8 percent to 89,563 tonnes in the first 10 months of 1996, the Futures Herald said on Monday, quoting customs figures.
Exports of uncast and raw copper in October alone were 12,751 tonnes, the newspaper said.
It said exports of uncast copper, including alloys, rose 11.2 percent to 33,336 tonnes in the first 10 months.
Exports of uncast copper were 5,598 tonnes in October alone.
China's imports of uncast and raw copper jumped 28.8 percent to 549,571 tonnes between January and October, the figures showed.
Imports of uncast and raw copper reached 82,655 tonnes in October alone.
Imports of uncast copper, including alloys, soared 50.1 percent to 216,962 tonnes in the first 10 months.
Imports of uncast copper were 39,144 tonnes in October alone.
